title: Posters — Stylistic range
slide_intent: Show how one poster message can take a determined, inspirational or celebratory tone without losing the organizer’s identity.
strategic_value: The mark and curve can unify campaigns with different emotional demands, from an athlete’s declaration to an invitation to a summer event.
demonstration: Three aligned posters compare a monochrome portrait and large red word, a forceful diagonal sports message, and a layered, multicolor Summer Games composition.
practical_value: Choose the simplest headline and image treatment that carries the event’s tone. Check the mark and curve across the set for continuity.

content_islands.name: Tone guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the statement of purpose and three numbered readings in a narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Three poster examples
content_islands.spec: Set three portrait posters at equal height across the page. Keep each headline, image treatment and identifying footer attached to its example.
